description: The sample repository's architecture policy: a small layered application that exercises every rule group.

conventions.dependencyArrowMeaning: A ProjectReference: the referencing project compiles against the referenced one.

responsibilities.name: Domain
responsibilities.purpose: The sample's domain model, its invariants and the storage port it owns.

responsibilities.name: Application
responsibilities.purpose: Coordinates the sample's use cases over the domain's ports.

responsibilities.name: Persistence
responsibilities.purpose: Adapters that implement the domain's storage port.

responsibilities.name: Composition
responsibilities.purpose: The sample's composition root, which selects an adapter and wires the handler.

responsibilities.name: Reporting
responsibilities.purpose: Read-only projections over the domain that serve the sample's legacy report.

discouragedProjectNames.reason: These name a category rather than a responsibility, so nothing can be kept out of them.

waivers.reason: The project name predates the catalogue and is referenced by a published pipeline; renaming it is a separate change.
